## Problem and change

Describe the problem, implementation, and compatibility impact.

## Verification

List exact commands, results, and any checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover successful and rejected behavior.
- [ ] No live keys, credentials, or recovery proofs are included.
- [ ] Storage-layout, authorization, and accounting changes are explained.
- [ ] No mainnet deployment, upgrade, or funding command was run.
- [ ] Third-party licenses and notices are preserved.
